# Planning permits: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Fee refunds must be offered when an application is withdrawn within 14 days, per the Fees Regulations. |
| C2 | Applications must be decided within 28 days under the Planning Act. |

## Backlog

US-1 As an applicant, I want to upload drawings so that the council can assess them.
US-2 As an applicant, I want my fee refunded if I withdraw within 14 days so that I do not lose money on a change of mind.
US-3 As an applicant, I want to pay the fee online so that I avoid a cheque.
US-4 As an applicant, I want to see the status of my application so that I know where it stands.
constraints: Fee refunds must be offered when an application is withdrawn within 14 days, per the Fees Regulations.
Applications must be decided within 28 days under the Planning Act.
